handoff.salientSummary: Implemented DELETE /api/v1/evaluations/:id endpoint for cancelling evaluations. The endpoint returns 200 for cancelling pending/running tasks (with status=cancelled), 409 for completed tasks, is idempotent for already cancelled tasks, returns 404 for not found, and 400 for invalid UUID format.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Added CancelEvaluation handler method to evaluation_handler.go with CancelEvaluationResponse struct. Added Cancel method to EvaluationRepository interface and PostgresEvaluationRepository implementation. Registered DELETE /api/v1/evaluations/:id route in main.go. Added 6 test cases covering all scenarios: pending task cancel (200), running task cancel (200), completed task conflict (409), already cancelled idempotent (200), not found (404), invalid UUID (400).

commandsRun.observation: All tests pass with coverage: handler 85.1%, cache 91.4%, repository 56.6%
